catalyst_rows.raw_text: Announced FDA's completion of its filing review and filing acceptance of the Company's supplemental New Drug Application (sNDA) for Ameluz PDT for the treatment of superficial basal cell carcinoma (sBCC), with a PDUFA target action date of September 28, 2026.

catalyst_rows.indication: mild-to-moderate actinic keratoses (AKs) on extremities, neck, and trunk
catalyst_rows.raw_text: Announced positive and statistically significant top-line results from its Phase 3 clinical trial evaluating Ameluz PDT for the treatment of mild to moderate actinic keratoses (AKs) on the extremities, neck, and trunk, meeting the primary endpoint.

Announced positive results of its Phase 2b clinical trial for the treatment of moderate to severe acne vulgaris (AV), with a 58% reduction in inflammatory lesions in the 3-hour incubation protocol with Ameluz PDT, compared to 37% with vehicle PDT (PPS).

catalyst_rows.indication: AK treatment field expansion (up to 240 cm2) on extremities/neck/trunk
catalyst_rows.raw_text: Announced database lock of Phase 1 pharmacokinetics study required for FDA filing on treatment field on extremities, neck and trunk with a treatment area of up to 240 cm2.

extractor_notes.tier0_overlap_check: Tier1 sharpens Ameluz PDT sBCC sNDA PDUFA Sept 28, 2026 (day-precision), Phase 3 AK extremities/neck/trunk topline (day-precision), Phase 2b acne vulgaris data (day-precision), and Phase 1 PK database lock for AK field expansion.
